fullPassage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult. Nature, however, may have provided us with solutions to these problems. Here are three areas where changes are already happening. About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then discarded. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many marine species in danger. With this in mind, scientists are turning to mealworms. Mealworms are the larvae of a certain species of beetle. Special bacteria live inside them. These bacteria can break down plastic. This means that mealworms can actually feed on plastic. Scientists are now looking for ways to cultivate the bacteria outside of mealworms. They also want to speed up the process by which the bacteria break down plastic. This may help us keep our landfills plastic-free. Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective. In time, we may be able to clean up our land with willow trees. Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel. The biofuel is renewable and sustainable, and it creates only a small amount of emissions. These are just a few solutions we can find in nature. There could be many more possible solutions to the problems we currently face. It seems that Mother Nature has given us one more chance. In return, we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean. If we do, the future of our planet may be bright after all.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ keeping → keep: help + 목적어 + 원형부정사이므로 keep
det.analysis:
① break: 'These bacteria can break down plastic'에서 조동사 can 뒤 동사원형 break가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② looking: 'Scientists are now looking for ways ~'에서 'be + -ing'의 현재진행형 looking이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ cultivate: 'ways to cultivate the bacteria'에서 ways를 꾸미는 to부정사(to cultivate)라 동사원형 cultivate가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ keeping → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'This may help us ___ our landfills plastic-free'에서 준사역동사 help는 'help + 목적어(us) + 원형부정사(또는 to부정사)'를 취해요. 따라서 keep(또는 to keep)으로 써야 해요. keeping(동명사/분사)은 올 수 없어 틀려요. ❌ keeping은 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: help + 목적어 + 원형부정사: help us keep

det.korean: ③ 자연이 우리의 환경 문제에 답을 제시한다
det.analysis:
글은 자연에서 찾은 세 가지 환경 문제 해결책을 소개하고, 자연이 우리에게 해결책을 제공했을지도 모른다고 말해요.

❌ ① Why Plastic Will Never Harm the Ocean(플라스틱이 결코 바다를 해치지 않는 이유): 본문은 플라스틱이 해양 종을 위험에 빠뜨린다 했으므로 반대예요.

❌ ② Coffee: The World's Most Popular Drink(커피: 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 음료): 커피는 예시일 뿐이에요.

✅ ③ Nature Offers Answers to Our Environmental Problems(자연이 우리의 환경 문제에 답을 제시한다): 'Nature ~ may have provided us with solutions to these problems'를 압축한 제목이에요 ←정답

❌ ④ The End of All Natural Disasters(모든 자연재해의 종말): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.
det.tip: 핵심 메시지 = 자연이 환경 문제의 해결책을 제공한다

ch: Why Plastic Will Never Harm the Ocean
Coffee: The World's Most Popular Drink
Nature Offers Answers to Our Environmental Problems
The End of All Natural Disasters

questions.passage: Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from <u>mountains of plastic</u>? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 mountains of plastic이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 처리하기 어려울 만큼 엄청나게 많은 양의 플라스틱 쓰레기
det.analysis:
밑줄 'mountains of plastic'은 '산더미 같은 플라스틱'이라는 비유 표현이에요. 앞에서 '점점 더 많은 쓰레기가 생산되고 플라스틱이 오염을 일으킨다'고 했고, 'Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic?'이라고 물으므로 '엄청나게 많은 플라스틱 쓰레기'를 뜻해요.

❌ ① 소량이 아니라 '엄청난 양'이에요.

✅ ② 처리하기 벅찰 만큼 많은 플라스틱 쓰레기를 과장해 표현한 것이에요 ←정답

❌ ③ 산을 보호하기 위한 제품이라는 내용은 없어요.

❌ ④ 실제 산 모양 구조물이 아니라 '많은 양'을 뜻하는 비유예요.
det.tip: mountains of ~ = 산더미 같은 ~ (엄청나게 많은 양)

ch: 산속에 따로 매립해 둔 소량의 플라스틱
처리하기 어려울 만큼 엄청나게 많은 양의 플라스틱 쓰레기
산을 보호하기 위해 특별히 만든 플라스틱 제품
플라스틱으로 만든 인공적인 산 모양의 구조물

questions.passage: About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then discarded. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw <u>them</u> away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 사람들이 버리는 플라스틱 제품들
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장: 'Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away?'(이 플라스틱 제품들을 버린 후 그것들이 어디로 가는지 생각해 본 적 있는가?). throw ___ away의 them은 바로 앞의 'these plastic items'를 받아요.

✅ ① 사람들이 버리는 플라스틱 제품들: them이 가리키는 바로 그 대상이에요 ←정답

❌ ② 재활용 공장은 언급되지 않았어요.

❌ ③ 해양 종은 뒤에 나오는 다른 대상이에요.

❌ ④ 과학자는 뒤 문단의 다른 대상이에요.
det.tip: these plastic items → throw them away: them = plastic items

questions.passage: These are just a few solutions we can find in nature. There could be many more possible solutions to the problems we currently face. It seems that Mother Nature has given us __________. In return, we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean. If we do, the future of our planet may be bright after all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 one more chance(또 한 번의 기회)가 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① one more chance(또 한 번의 기회): 자연이 해결책을 제공했고, 보답으로 환경을 지킬 방법을 더 찾아야 한다는 흐름이므로, 대자연이 우리에게 '또 한 번의 기회'를 준 것 같다는 문맥에 적절 ← 정답
❌ ② a final warning(마지막 경고): 보답으로 노력하자는 긍정적 흐름과 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ no other option(다른 선택지 없음): 본문 흐름과 무관
❌ ④ a huge electricity bill(막대한 전기 요금): 문맥과 전혀 무관
det.tip: Mother Nature has given us one more chance: 대자연이 또 한 번의 기회를 주다

questions.passage: Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. __________. With this in mind, scientists are turning to mealworms. Mealworms are the larvae of a certain species of beetle. Special bacteria live inside them.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"이것은 많은 해양 종을 위험에 빠뜨린다." (7단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) danger, in, many, marine, puts, species, This 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: This puts many marine species in danger
det.analysis:
주어 '이것'은 This로 시작해요: This.

동사 '빠뜨린다'는 주어 This(단수)에 맞춰 puts로 써요: puts.

무엇을 빠뜨리는가 하면 '많은 해양 종'이에요: many + marine + species.

'위험에'는 in danger로 마무리해요: in + danger.

순서대로 이으면 This / puts / many / marine / species / in / danger.
det.tip: 단수 주어 This + puts, put A in danger(A를 위험에 빠뜨리다)

questions.wa: This puts many marine species in danger
accept: This puts many marine species in danger

questions.passage: More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is __________ (cause) problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: causing (현재진행형).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'Plastic ~ is ___ problems'에서 빈칸은 be동사 is 뒤의 자리예요. 문맥상 '현재 일으키고 있는 중'이라는 진행의 의미이므로 'be + -ing'의 현재진행형을 만들어야 해요. 따라서 cause를 causing으로 바꿔 'is causing(일으키고 있다)'으로 써요.
det.tip: be동사 + -ing(현재진행): is causing

questions.passage: Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, __________. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"우리는 사용된 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿈으로써 온실가스 배출을 줄일 수 있다." (13단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) biofuel, by, can, coffee, emissions, gas, greenhouse, grounds, into, reduce, turning, used, we 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 13단어로 쓸 것 (by + 동명사 활용)

det.korean: we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel
det.analysis:
주어와 조동사는 '우리는 ~할 수 있다'로 we can이에요: we + can.

'온실가스 배출을 줄이다'는 reduce greenhouse gas emissions예요: reduce + greenhouse + gas + emissions.

'~함으로써'는 'by + 동명사'를 써요. '사용된 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿈으로써'이므로 by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel이에요: by + turning + used + coffee + grounds + into + biofuel.

순서대로 이으면 we / can / reduce / greenhouse / gas / emissions / by / turning / used / coffee / grounds / into / biofuel.
det.tip: by + 동명사(turning): ~함으로써, turn A into B(A를 B로 바꾸다)

questions.wa: we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel
accept: we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel

questions.passage: This may help us keep our landfills plastic-free. __________. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"광산업과 다른 산업들이 전 세계적으로 토양 오염을 일으키고 있다."

[ across / and / are / causing / globe / industries / Mining / other / pollution / soil / the ] (11단어) (영어로)

det.korean: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe
det.analysis:
주어는 '광산업과 다른 산업들'이에요: Mining + and + other + industries.

동사는 '일으키고 있다'로 주어가 복수이므로 현재진행형 are causing을 써요: are + causing.

'토양 오염을'은 soil pollution이에요: soil + pollution.

'전 세계적으로'는 across the globe예요: across + the + globe.

순서대로 이으면 Mining / and / other / industries / are / causing / soil / pollution / across / the / globe.
det.tip: 복수 주어 + are causing(현재진행), across the globe(전 세계적으로)

questions.wa: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe
accept: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe

questions.passage: These are just a few solutions we can find in nature. There could be many more possible solutions to the problems we currently face. It seems that Mother Nature has given us one more chance. In return, we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean. If we do, __________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"우리 지구의 미래는 결국 밝을지도 모른다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) after, all, be, bright, future, may, of, our, planet, the 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: the future of our planet may be bright after all
det.analysis:
주어는 '우리 지구의 미래'예요: the + future + of + our + planet.

'~일지도 모른다'는 추측의 조동사 may를 쓰고 뒤에 동사원형 be가 와요: may + be.

'밝은'은 보어 bright예요: bright.

'결국'은 after all로 마무리해요: after + all.

순서대로 이으면 the / future / of / our / planet / may / be / bright / after / all.
det.tip: 조동사 may + be + 형용사(bright), after all(결국)

questions.wa: the future of our planet may be bright after all
accept: the future of our planet may be bright after all
